Winson, the $220.99 from your swap to the Thor P2 was issued on October 29 as store credit, not as a refund to your PayPal. It's on your HeliumDeploy account now, the full $220.99 unused, and it applies automatically at checkout on your next order.

I know you asked for it to go back to your original payment instead, and I'm sorry that hasn't been answered yet. I've passed that request to the team again. They're offline right now, and they'll pick it up tomorrow morning and email you their answer.

Noted, Winson. The team's answer will come to your email.

Before you go, one quick question: you were looking at the Thor P2 page again tonight. Were you thinking about a second one, or just checking the details for your setup?

Winson, your Thor P2 shipped from our Tennessee warehouse on October 30 and has been in transit to (address hidden) since November 4. The carrier puts delivery at November 19, so it's still on schedule.

The international leg is with APC, tracking ····:
(tracking link hidden)

That link should show the latest scans, including customs in Malaysia. If nothing has arrived by November 19, message me here and I'll look into it.
